outcome: combined and triple screening test application rates
cohort: 8103 Syrian refugee pregnant women and 47,151 Turkish citizen pregnant women who gave birth between January 2013 and December 2018 at a tertiary center in Izmir
finding: Syrian refugee pregnant women had higher rates of adolescent pregnancy, preterm birth, and anemia, but lower rates of cesarean section, combined/triple screening tests, and gestational diabetes screening compared to Turkish citizen pregnant women.
mod_finding: Primary cesarean section rates were significantly lower in Syrian refugee mothers compared to Turkish citizens.
